item: Main's red from the 1 October burst: unused names in a test, three French strings that said flux for lane
summary: Push CI on main (run 6704) failed three jobs: the blocking ruff step on an unused import and loop variable in tests/test_trending_rank_order.py, which skipped the rest of the ubuntu job, and the glossary guard in tests/test_rewalk_b29_fixes.py on three French run-clock strings that wrote flux where the glossary requires voie. The names were removed and the strings reworded; nothing else changed.
